about_the_game:
Play as Kora, a raptor racing against a volcanic eruption to rescue dinosaur eggs across a panicked world. Every level is a bite-sized challenge full of hazards, clever routes, and time-based goals. Collect Ambers, beat your best times, and unlock deeper challenges in a vibrant, extinction-level adventure built for casual players, but one that really unfolds and rewards players who want to push their skills.

Jurassic Parkour is about mastering movement and optimizing your route. Kora is always running, but you control when to jump and precision is everything. Each level is a tightly designed, single-screen challenge where you’ll be collecting eggs and dodging evolving hazards against the clock. There's no wrong paths, but there are definitely quicker ones. It's up to you to find the most efficient routes in each level.

With no fail states and instant restarts, the game encourages experimentation, speedrunner-like runs, and continuous improvement. The better you play, the more you unlock, from time-based collectibles to entirely new game modes! And as your skills improve, you’ll discover tighter routes that reward smart planning and clean execution. It’s a game of knowledge and planning, where knowing the right path matters more than reflexes or button combos.

Features:

  • Fluid auto-runner platforming with tight, responsive jumping

  • 100+ handcrafted and hand drawn, single-screen levels with escalating hazards

  • Time-based collectibles and leaderboard challenges

  • Focused on replay value through route refinement, speedy tricks and clean execution

  • Built for flow, mastery, and the joy of improving each run

  • A light, fun narrative woven through dinosaur interactions about escaping a catastrophe

  • Unlockable Frenzy and Archeology modes that remix gameplay (Archeology not in demo)

  • Speedrun-friendly design with instant restarts and no harsh fail states

You don’t need to be super fast to finish, but if you are, there’s a lot more waiting for you. Like the challenge of collecting the Golden Eggs. Once unlocked you'll need to collect eggs in quick succession to reveal the Golden Egg but if you take too long, the counter resets and you'll need to build that chain again. Are you fast enough to gather them all?

Capture each Golden Egg in an area and you'll unlock FRENZY MODE for all those levels! This introduces arcade chaos, you'll need to collect 40 eggs in 60 seconds using all kinds of power ups to help you achieve your goal. If you do, you'll earn a Raptor Claw and get a little closer to 100% completing the demo (they'll unlock a NEW mode in the full game - Archeology!).

Built for casual players, perfectionists, retro nostalgic players, speedrunners, dinosaur lovers, completionists and anyone who gets joy from beating their personal best - or others on the leaderboards! Can you gather every egg and collectible, master every shortcut, conquer every mode, save your dinosaur friends and escape before the volcano erupts?

short_description: Jurassic Parkour is a 2D auto-running precision platformer where you play as a raptor. Control Kora by timing jumps to dodge hazards, collect eggs, and unlock new modes. Nail tight, responsive movement across 100+ handcrafted levels. It's easy to pick up, rewarding and fun to master.
